name: Portrait-NeRF
definition: A method for estimating Neural Radiance Fields from a single headshot portrait image. It addresses the ill-posed nature of training an MLP from a single image by pretraining the MLP with a meta-learning framework on a light stage dataset and finetuning it on the input image.
summary: Portrait-NeRF reconstructs full portraits from a single image using meta-learning and canonical warping, unlike standard NeRF which requires multiple views.
